svg.text: Carrier board (in the bee), part by part
Same name = joined. Red: battery, blue: signal.
Q1's gate is at GND: with the battery the right way round
it conducts, and reversed it blocks. SW1 switches the whole
box; F1 is a resettable fuse; D1 shows the power is on.
upper branch: left ear, lower branch: right ear
Power pads of each ear block (the same names on both)
